market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver futures currently trade near $32/oz.  A rise to $120 would be a 3.75× move, far beyond the all‑time high of ~$50.  Using a lognormal diffusion model with σ=35% annual volatility and even a generous 10% annual drift, the probability of touching $120 before end‑of‑June 2026 is well below 1%, while the market implies 6.6%.
evidence_points: Needed log‑return ≈ 1.322; with σ=0.35, 1‑touch probability ≈ 0.2–0.6% even with generous drift.
Market implied probability 6.6% is an order of magnitude too high.
